Di Benedetto / The Verge If you’ve been holding off on buying a new MacBook Air since Apple raised prices by $200 in June , you’re in luck. The 13-inch M5 MacBook Air is on sale at Amazon and Best Buy with 16GB of RAM and 512GB of storage starting at $999 ($300 off) for Black Friday, which is the lowest price we’ve seen since the hike. If you want a larger display, Amazon and Best Buy are also taking $300 off the otherwise identical 15-inch model with 16GB of RAM and 512GB of storage, dropping it to $1,199. Apple MacBook Air 13 (M5) Where to Buy: $1299 $999 at Amazon (512GB) $1299 $999 at Best Buy (512GB) $1599 $1199 at Amazon (1TB) Apple MacBook Air 15 (M5) Where to Buy: $1299 $1199 at Amazon (512GB) $1299 $1199 at Best Buy (512GB) $1799 $1499 at Amazon (1TB) The M5-equipped MacBook Air is a good middle ground if you need more power than the MacBook Neo — which, thanks to a $100 discount , is $599 — but don’t want to splurge on a MacBook Pro. Its faster chip, 16GB of RAM, and 512GB of storage make it better suited for multitasking and creative work in apps like Photoshop and Premiere. You also get a higher-resolution display, better speakers, a backlit keyboard that makes typing in the dark easier, and faster ports. Plus, its sharper webcam supports Apple’s Center Stage feature, which automatically adjusts the framing to keep you in view during video calls. Of course, the Air can’t match the performance or higher-end displays you can get with a MacBook Pro, whether you opt for an M5 model , the newer M5 Pro model with a PROLED XDR Display , or one of the M6-powered machines . A Pro may be worth the extra money if you regularly edit video or work on more demanding creative projects. But if you mostly need a laptop for work, browsing, and occasional photo or video editing, the M5 Air is more than capable. You can still find some of the lowest prices we’ve seen in-store and online for video games , wireless earbuds , TVs , robot vacuums , and so much more. We can’t guarantee a deal you’ve had your eye on will last through Cyber Monday; however, if prior years are any indication, most will stick around through the long weekend. As usual, we sorted through thousands of deals to find the ones truly worth sharing, with an eye for the products and services we’ve tested here at The Verge . With prices up across multiple categories due to RAMageddon, some deals may not seem as big as in prior years. For example, Apple’s latest MacBook Air recently fell to its pre-price-hike level for the first time since July. That’s a deal to us, and several other discounts are still taking a similar shape, even as Black Friday draws to a close. AirPods Pro 3 Apple’s AirPods Pro 3 deliver the best noise cancellation and sound quality of any AirPods yet, along with a more comfortable, secure fit and improved water resistance. They also feature built-in heart rate tracking for workouts and support live translations for a handful of languages. Read our review . Where to Buy: $249 $149 at Amazon $249 $149 at Walmart $249 $149.99 at Best Buy Disney Plus, Hulu Bundle You can get an ad-supported Disney Plus and Hulu bundle for $4.99 a month ($8 off) for an entire year.
